notes: Seven movable-part episodes are visible. The paired coat-closet and laundry-closet leaves are reported separately because each leaf is independently manipulated. Their closing order is partly obscured, so those off-frame estimates have lower confidence. The initial hallway survey and final approach to the desk/piano do not show additional state changes.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user opens and later closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
